g.text: Server-side session maintenance for Streamable HTTP is NOT documented by
Microsoft Learn (checked 2026-08-04). The deprecated SSE transport documents an
Azure Queue Storage backplane (AzureWebJobsStorage); Streamable HTTP has no
documented equivalent. host.json encryptClientState (default true) suggests
client-carried state, but the mechanism is undocumented. Drawn as a boundary,
not a claim. The tool sees a SessionId on its invocation context (extension source).
All nine messages transit API Management as MCP
passthrough. Learn does not document APIM altering
Mcp-Session-Id, so no gateway session handling is shown.
